case.title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH. Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter. Need: 4580 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 54 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200003. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70530.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
sup:70530.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
sup:70530.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
message.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

You laid out copper and labour as the pressure on your cost structure, and a binding volume is what makes that pressure easier to carry. All three of our options give you a binding volume over a longer contract term, which is more planning certainty than your offer provides.

Our forecast for Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 rises 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).

On our order history with you:
Our orders of Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 with you were placed at EUR 414.61 on 2024-10-14 (po:4500011548-10), EUR 400.19 on 2025-06-30 (po:4500012634-10), EUR 412.74 on 2026-01-27 (po:4500013491-10) and EUR 412.74 on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014465-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 418.79; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 416.33; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 415.11; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Binding volume in every option: 4,580 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Selvbrunn the longest commitment on volume and term, and it sits close to the prices we have paid so far. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

That gives Selvbrunn planning security for production and material purchasing.

Please take Option A to the committee. If it needs anything further to decide, tell us and we will provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
message.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge your verified volume forecast and historical order data, which allows us to adjust our position. As to the price history and volume change data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? While a 24-month contract provides mutual planning security, extended payment terms of 90 days are not feasible for us. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €431.63 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. 

We therefore propose a unit price of EUR 429.43 based on your Option C, with 4,580 units per year over 24 months and 45 days net payment. Alternatively, we offer a price of €429.43 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. 

This Angebot stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Legal Department: Please note that our general terms and conditions apply to this process; furthermore, the quote lists our standard terms.

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

message.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
message.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

You asked which volume we can commit to, and you said a binding higher volume can improve the price. Every option below answers that with a binding volume over a longer contract term, so you get the planning security you describe.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 84.6% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70530@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 420.71; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 413.18; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 5,496 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 418.24; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Binding volume in every option: 4,580 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve: it gives you the binding volume and the longer term you asked for, while the other terms stay where our delivery record says they should. We can meet you on these other terms, and we are firm that this is a serious effort to close.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

For your pricing committee, this paragraph can go forward unchanged: Hollerau Pumpenwerke offers a binding volume over a longer contract term, with a price that stays well within the frozen-price framework your management has set. Option A gives Selvbrunn a firm volume, a long planning horizon and a clear, ready-to-sign order.

Please take Option A to the committee. If it needs any further material for its approval, tell us and we will provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
